acceptanceCriteria: About 2,000 Markdown files with about 13,000 custom-syntax citations are checked in one invocation within bounded memory.
Each finding names document, line and citation.
An unparseable citation is reported, never skipped.
Spec/requirement updated in the same change.
body: tests citations --docs supports one syntax and at most 256 documents. Add a named profile or capture-group pattern (repo, path, start/end line, symbol, revision), stream documents via manifest/glob in bounded memory, keep existing findings and add per-document totals. Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1224
title: GH #1224: tests citations accepts a configurable citation syntax and streams corpora past the 256-document cap
